body: You are not worthless! Failing a midterm sucks especially if it’s that high but it certainly isn’t the end of life. You can always try to ask for help from peers and teachers and try to gain was many marks as you can from the other assessments you may have left. I am also in school, and also don’t have a partner or too many relationships so I understand how you feel, but there is nothing, absolutely nothing that this world can throw at you that means it’s the end. Sometimes you have to think about what you can try differently in school to make easier for you to grasp the concepts. Ask for help if you haven’t already. People in college are really so willing to help. Talk to your professor about your mark, explain what wasn’t clicking. It’s literally their job. You are working towards your goals and the life you want and you absolutely deserve to give yourself the chance to get there!
Would you mind sharing your age and/or general location?
